question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: Lites flickered in the bussh behind him.
Lights flicered in the bush behind him.
Lights flikered in the bush behind him.
Lights flickered in the bush behind him.

solution:
Here the correct answer is** **'Lights flickered in the bush behind him.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence with no spelling error is: Lights flickered in the bush behind him.
 
• This sentence is correct because all the words are spelled accurately.
 
• "Lights" is the correct spelling of the word referring to sources of illumination.
 
• "Flickered" is the correct past tense form of the verb "flicker," meaning to shine or flutter intermittently.
 
• "In" and "the" are common prepositions and articles, respectively.
 
• "The" is used before "bush" to specify a particular bush.
 
• "Behind" is a preposition indicating the location in relation to something else.
 
• "Him" is the correct pronoun used as an object of the preposition.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4) "Lights flickered in the bush behind him" because it does not contain any spelling errors and accurately conveys the intended meaning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's analyze the other options:
 
• **Lites flickered in the bussh behind him.**
 
• Spelling errors: "Lites" should be spelled as "Lights," and "bussh" should be spelled as "bush." Both words have incorrect spellings, rendering the sentence incorrect.
 
• **Lights flicered in the bush behind him.**
 
• Spelling error: "Flicered" should be spelled as "flickered." The missing "k" makes this sentence incorrect.
 
• **Lights flikered in the bush behind him.**
 
• Spelling error: "Flikered" should be spelled as "flickered." The missing "c" makes this sentence incorrect.
